title: Meidum pyramid as collapsed test structure

tellings.quote: We then have intermediary structures like the pyramid of my doom in the fume oasis which was a test structure that was designed to model and implement the same physics and chemistry as the red pyramid. There was a catastrophic collapse.

plain: The pyramid at Meidum, near the Faiyum oasis in Egypt, was built as a test structure to model the same physics and chemistry as the Red Pyramid, and it failed in a catastrophic collapse. That is the account of Geoffrey Drumm, a pyramid researcher, who tells it to Michels without naming a source. It fits his view that the pyramids were machines, built by trial and error, rather than tombs.
